name: Valmadrid (Spain)
description: Yellow field with a blue hoist part with a dancetty edge bearing a yellow tree with a monogram between two ears of wheat.
history: Municipal flag of Valmadrid; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: stripe with a dancetty (zigzag) edge along the hoist
tree bearing a monogram of the letters V and M, between two ears of wheat
